messages:
jenna (support): Hey team — escalating Zendesk #4621. Customer couldn't start free trial because checkout demanded card-on-file and their 3DS kept failing. Promo code PROMO2026 didn't apply so no trial credits. They hit this around 2026-02-15 14:18 UTC. Customer email: user***@example.com.

jenna (support): Key error in our payments logs: `authentication_required`. Attaching the snippet below.

jenna (support): ```json
{
  "status": 402,
  "error": {
    "type": "card_error",
    "code": "authentication_required",
    "message": "3DS authentication required",
    "payment_intent": "pi_3Kxxxxx",
    "next_action": {"type": "use_stripe_sdk"}
  }
}
```

simon (billing): Thanks. Which payment gateway? Stripe? Any attempt id/charge id?

jenna (support): Stripe. PI is pi_3Kxxxxx (masked above). No charge posted. Customer tried 3 times, last attempt shows `challenge_flow_timeout`.

ops-bot: [webhook] payment_intent.updated pi_3Kxxxxx -> status: requires_action, last_payment_error.code: authentication_required, challenge_status: failed, failure_reason: challenge_flow_timeout

arjun (eng): Quick guess: frontend didn't surface the next_action/use_stripe_sdk flow to the browser, so Stripe's redirect/iframe never completed. Do we have frontend logs for the /checkout flow?

jenna (support): Customer says the 3DS iframe popped then immediately closed and spinner stayed. They were on Chrome 120, desktop. Attached screenshot to ticket: https://s3.redwood/support/zd4621/3ds-shot.png

mira (product): This is sensitive — we require card on file for trial in EU due to fraud policy, but if 3DS fails we should either retry or surface a clear error + allow manual escalation. Manual trial grant acceptable case-by-case.

simon (billing): I'll refund any auth holds and manually grant trial credits for this customer. Please confirm when done so I can note on ticket.

jenna (support): Refund/void requested (action id act_9Yzz). Also manually granted promo/trial credits: grant_2026_4621. Customer notified, asked to retry.

arjun (eng): I'll put up a small patch to ensure client handles next_action.use_stripe_sdk and shows the Stripe modal reliably; also add a retry on `challenge_flow_timeout`. Will target a fix in next patch (PR in review).

mira (product): Nice. Also please add telemetry so we can see how often PROMO2026 fails vs payment auth failures.

jenna (support): Follow-ups: I updated Zendesk with note, customer replied :thumbsup: for manual grant. Closing loop after deploy.

arjun (eng): Assigning to me: ENG-issue-#2487. Will post PR link here.

simon (billing): Assigning to billing review: BILL-312 for policy tweak (allow single manual grant for auth_failures).

jenna (support): Thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now.
